title: Closures in loops
statement: Which of these loops print 0, 1 and 2 (in that order) when run on their own (Node.js 22, run as a script with node main.js)? Pick every one that applies.
choices: for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) setTimeout(() => console.log(i));
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) setTimeout(() => console.log(i));
for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) setTimeout(() => console.log(i), i);
for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) setTimeout(console.log, 0, i);
